name: superplan
description: Conversation-scoped persistent planning with task-completion gating, pressure-gated checkpoints, risk-aware deferred Stop recovery, cumulative history, and concurrent-session isolation for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Conversation-scoped persistent planning for Codex and Claude Code (Linux/WSL)
interface.longDescription: Persist one conversation-scoped plan container with a task-completion-gated current-task plan, cumulative detailed findings/progress, pressure-gated checkpoints, concurrent session isolation, bounded compaction recovery, and risk-aware deferred Stop reconciliation. Works in both Codex and Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $superplan to keep one persistent plan container across later tasks in this conversation.
